verdict.rationale: Datalab documents schema-based structured extraction with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability. Nothing in the evidence shows per-field confidence scores, calibration, or a human-in-the-loop review path that routes low-confidence fields to reviewers. Bounding-box citations are an adjacent auditability feature, not confidence scoring or review routing.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields
